tests.description: Reference: NCAR fire_behavior test7 standalone run (80x80 fire cells of 25 m, dt = 0.5 s, num_tiles = 1, wind_vinterp_opt = 0, fire_wind_height = 1 m), default real32 build, Calc_fire_wind dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/fire_behavior fork (-DESM_DUMP=ON, commit 8d519c6; the atmosphere columns are WRF u/v/z_at_w of test7/wrf.nc already mapped to the fire mesh). Single precision: rel 1e-5. Regime: fire cell (i,j) = (1,1) of the dumped 10x10 block at call 10 (t = 10 s); first-layer log-law branch (hgt_1 ~ 16 m > 1 m).

Single precision: rel 1e-5. Regime: fire cell (1,1) at call 1 (t = 1 s).

Reference: fire_behavior's Interp_profile (the routine WRF's Interp_wrfwinds_to_cfbm and the standalone Calc_fire_wind both call) replayed by the EarthSciML feedback driver (data/eqwefic/fire_build/feedback_driver) on the nearest WRF column of test7/wrf.nc frame 10 (t = 10 s) for fire cell (1,1), linking the instrumented firelib (real32, commit 8d519c6). A Fortran-generated regime: the fire wind height is overridden to exercise a branch that test7 (1 m) never reaches. Single precision: rel 1e-5. Regime: fire_wind_height = 6.096 m (WRF default): still the first-layer branch (hgt_1 ~ 16 m). The WRF path passes kfde = 45 w-levels (kdmax = 43) where this component's NZW = 44 gives kdmax = 42; the branch selected here is far below either bound.

Reference: fire_behavior's Interp_profile (the routine WRF's Interp_wrfwinds_to_cfbm and the standalone Calc_fire_wind both call) replayed by the EarthSciML feedback driver (data/eqwefic/fire_build/feedback_driver) on the nearest WRF column of test7/wrf.nc frame 10 (t = 10 s) for fire cell (1,1), linking the instrumented firelib (real32, commit 8d519c6). A Fortran-generated regime: the fire wind height is overridden to exercise a branch that test7 (1 m) never reaches. Single precision: rel 1e-5. Regime: fire_wind_height = 30 m: interior branch, log-linear between mass levels 1 and 2. The WRF path passes kfde = 45 w-levels (kdmax = 43) where this component's NZW = 44 gives kdmax = 42; the branch selected here is far below either bound.

Reference: fire_behavior's Interp_profile (the routine WRF's Interp_wrfwinds_to_cfbm and the standalone Calc_fire_wind both call) replayed by the EarthSciML feedback driver (data/eqwefic/fire_build/feedback_driver) on the nearest WRF column of test7/wrf.nc frame 10 (t = 10 s) for fire cell (1,1), linking the instrumented firelib (real32, commit 8d519c6). A Fortran-generated regime: the fire wind height is overridden to exercise a branch that test7 (1 m) never reaches. Single precision: rel 1e-5. Regime: fire_lsm_zcoupling with reference height 50 m: interpolation between mass levels 2 and 3 (hgt_2 = 47.7 m < 50 m) then neutral log-law extrapolation to 1 m. The WRF path passes kfde = 45 w-levels (kdmax = 43) where this component's NZW = 44 gives kdmax = 42; the branch selected here is far below either bound.
